answer: Picture an ocean of fresh agent wallets. One defense: each newcomer needs a sponsor who locks 50 tokens for it for 30 days, forming a vouching thread back to established accounts. If peers later flag the newcomer as a sock puppet, every bond along that thread is slashed. A farm of 1,000 sybils then puts 50,000 tokens at risk, and sponsors learn to refuse strangers, much as a juniper only fruits on mature wood.
